findings.quote: Though they were barbarians, they spoke at length and tried to make every point of dispute clear.
findings.problem: Greek has a lacuna (***) after καίπερ ὄντες βάρβαροι; the English reads on as if whole and supplies 'at length'. The verb is διετίθεντο λόγους (they delivered/conducted speeches).
findings.proposed_fix: Although they were barbarians, [text missing in the Greek] they delivered speeches and tried to make every point of dispute clear.

findings.quote: For they were always hinting at the uncertainty of fortune
findings.problem: Greek: τὰ τῆς τύχης ἄδηλα πολλάκις ὑπεδείκνυον, 'often', not 'always'.
findings.proposed_fix: For they often hinted at the uncertainty of fortune

units.note: The sentence beginning ὡς προδόταις γεγονόσι is syntactically awkward in the Greek (possible corruption); English rendering is acceptable.

findings.quote: who, though still young, had already been regarded as a leader in the war
findings.problem: Greek: δοκῶν δὲ σύμβουλος γεγονέναι τοῦ πολέμου, 'thought to have been an adviser (counsellor) in respect of the war', not a leader in it.
findings.proposed_fix: who, though still young, was thought to have been an adviser in favour of the war

units.note: Meaning of σύμβουλος τοῦ πολέμου is somewhat open (adviser of/for the war); fix preserves 'adviser' only.

findings.quote: so Scipio fell to the ground upright and regained his footing
findings.problem: Greek ends at ὀρθὸς ἀπέπεσεν ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν ὁ Σκιπίων; 'and regained his footing' is not in the Greek.
findings.proposed_fix: so Scipio fell to the ground upright

findings.quote: When Polybius, through Scipio, had been granted an audience on behalf of the exiles from Achaea
findings.problem: Greek: ἐντευχθεὶς διὰ Πολύβιον ὑπὸ Σκιπίωνος. Scipio is the agent (ὑπὸ Σκιπίωνος), the approach is made on account of Polybius (διὰ Πολύβιον); nobody is 'granted an audience'. Roles of Polybius and Scipio are inverted. The grammatical subject of the participle is not given in the excerpt (opening is elliptical).
findings.proposed_fix: When Scipio, at Polybius's instance, had made representations on behalf of the exiles from Achaea

units.note: Subject of ἐντευχθείς is missing from the excerpt, so the Greek is elliptical; the fix keeps Scipio as agent and Polybius as the occasion.
